C01 and C23 share section 350 authority and language about entering a trade agreement through a duly empowered plenipotentiary, but those are general trade-agreement formulas embedded in much more elaborate GATT implementation machinery. C15 has a relatively compact sequence in which specified treaty conditions are satisfied and an operative legal consequence is proclaimed, but it terminates an earlier proclamation and does not use the child’s exchange-and-entry-into-force mechanism.
